content.short: Cardano Robots is a collectible art project created on Cardano Blockchain as NFT with total supply 2,590 unique.
content.description: Cardano Robots is a collectible NFT art project minted as native assets on the Cardano blockchain. The collection features robot characters with different editions, traits, and rarity profiles, including larger friendly robot editions and smaller gold-themed editions. Each piece is intended to be a unique digital collectible for Cardano NFT holders. The project focuses on character art, limited supply, rarity, and ownership of robot-themed NFTs rather than marketplace infrastructure or trading tools.
